item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Like Decibelle said, this isn't the same Nobody. Neither of the Nobodies in this tale are that Nobody. The Nobody in Anart Antics is, however, that Nobody. There's more than one Nobody, is what I'm getting at. Each one has their own unique hat, and each hat has its own special properties.

And as for conflicts with Cool War- I'll go ahead and say, with the aided context Satan provides in this tale, Acidverse is spread across multiple universes across the baselines with some differences between each iteration. For example, the idea that Nobody from Cool War is every major GOI leader (like the head of the HI, Wondertainment, etc), does not apply to any of my writing despite the fact it very obviously draws from Cool War. The Old Wondertainment might have died around the time Cool War concluded, but it has nothing to do with Nobody dying. (also I will probably write about Old Wondertainment dying)

"No," the radio crackered, "you are the anomalies!"
And then Finnegan was Nobody.

Joking aside, I like the idea that Nobody is more than one person, but really isn't anyone at all. This was pretty surreal, no lie, but I'm really interested to see where it goes, since the last installment wasn't as tantalizing.
